title: Vicar of Bray
html_source:
(Biography) a vicar (Simon Aleyn) appointed to the parish of Bray in Berkshire during Henry VIII’s reign who changed his faith to Catholic when Mary I was on the throne and back to Protestant when Elizabeth I succeeded and so retained his living.
The Free Dictionary
Thus anyone who changes his beliefs to suit external events.

Also a song.
